title: Aureline M5 start-work sheet
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a start-work sheet. Names the object class, its change-intent association, the tracked item it launches from, and each start-work side effect (branch, worktree, review draft, provider link) disclosed separately — so start work never silently creates a side effect without disclosure. Downstream the start-work sheet, work-item detail, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating start-work behavior by hand. Raw command lines, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
